# Extreme Blinds Works

> Blinds shop in Ashok Nagar, Kandivali East, Mumbai, run by Aashik and Abdeali since 2008. We measure, make, fit and repair window blinds for homes, offices, temples and mandirs across all of Mumbai, Thane, Navi Mumbai and Mira-Bhayandar. Rated 4.6/5 from 82 ratings on JustDial.

## Blinds we make

- Roller blinds: sheer, dim-out, linen-textured or blackout fabric on a bead-chain tube. From ₹120 per sq ft.
- Zebra blinds: alternating sheer and solid bands for light control without lifting.
- Wooden and venetian blinds: real wood, wood-grain, and 25 mm aluminium slats. Aluminium from ₹950 per piece, wood-grain from ₹1,200.
- Bamboo, jute and chick blinds: natural bamboo and PVC chick for balconies and verandahs. Bamboo chick from ₹65 per sq ft.
- Blackout blinds: for bedrooms, kids' rooms and home theatres.
- Vertical blinds: for tall windows, sliding doors and office cabins.
- Monsoon blinds: transparent 0.5 mm PVC, crank-operated, keeps rain off balconies. From ₹185 per sq ft.
- Custom-printed and mandir blinds: any photo, artwork or deity printed on a roller blind.
- Glass films (frosted and printed) and repairs for venetian, roller and vertical blinds.

Prices are starting prices; the final quote depends on size and fabric, after measuring.

## How it works

1. WhatsApp a photo of the window or call.
2. We visit, measure and help choose the type and fabric.
3. Quote per square foot or per piece.
4. We make the blinds to size and our own team installs them.

## Common questions

- How much do blinds cost in Mumbai? Bamboo chick blinds start at ₹65 per sq ft, roller blinds at ₹120 per sq ft, monsoon blinds at ₹185 per sq ft, and aluminium venetian blinds at ₹950 per piece. Exact quote after measuring.
- Do you repair old blinds? Yes: venetian, roller and vertical blinds, including ones installed by other shops.
- Can you print my own photo on a blind? Yes. Any image (deity for a mandir, artwork, family photo, pattern) printed on a roller blind sized to the window.
- Which blinds are best for the monsoon? Transparent PVC monsoon blinds for balconies and terraces; bamboo and PVC chick blinds handle humidity indoors.
- Which blinds are best for bedrooms? Blackout roller blinds block the most light; zebra blinds give daylight with privacy.
- Roller vs zebra blinds? A roller blind is one sheet of fabric; a zebra blind has alternating sheer and solid bands that control light without lifting.
- Best blinds for kitchens and bathrooms? 25 mm aluminium venetian blinds; they handle moisture and wipe clean.
- Which areas do you cover? All of Mumbai (Kandivali, Borivali, Malad, Andheri, Bandra, South Mumbai and more), plus Thane, Navi Mumbai and Mira-Bhayandar.
